QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Samples for Discovery
QuestInfo.0: Try to activate the Ryuul Data Collector.
QuestInfo.1: You can get the data the Ryuul asked for by placing 300 Drake Cell Samples in the Data Collector.
QuestInfo.2: While extracting the analysis data, you asked Surana why it's so important to collect data from Maple World. The details are incredibly complicated, and Surana seems very dedicated to cooperation and discovery. You can tell this is a worthy endeavor.
